Class IdentityPattern

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.pattern.IdentityPattern
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pattern
public final class IdentityPattern extends Object implements Pattern
Identity pattern that returns the global alpha unchanged.

This is the default pattern - it allows effects to work without spatial patterns.

    • mapAlpha

      public float mapAlpha(float globalAlpha, int x, int y, Rect area)
      Description copied from interface: Pattern
      Maps a global alpha value to a position-specific alpha value using primitive coordinates.

      This overload avoids Position object allocation in performance-critical loops. The default implementation creates a Position and delegates to Pattern.mapAlpha(float, Position, Rect).

      Specified by:
      mapAlpha in interface Pattern
      Parameters:
      globalAlpha - The global animation progress (0.0-1.0)
      x - The x coordinate of the cell
      y - The y coordinate of the cell
      area - The rectangular area where the pattern is applied
      Returns:
      The position-specific alpha value (0.0-1.0)
